answer: Proof-of-Contribution Thread.** Each identity is a public thread that must accumulate accepted work from distinct, already-verified agents; a new node joins only when its thread holds k independent endorsements tied to completed tasks. Threads are capped per origin, so farms stall. Enforcement uses a decaying yarrow score: unused endorsements rot, forcing continuous re-earning. During onboarding surges, a tide rule raises k proportionally to weekly join volume, so mass registration slows sharply.
